/* master.mpst.selectAgingItemMaster*/ SELECT A.SITE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM,'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY/MM') AS YYYYMM, B.TEXT1 AS SITE_NAME, A.ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, TO_CHAR(A.STOCK_QTY, '999,999,999,999,990') AS STOCK_QTY, TO_CHAR(A.STOCK_PRICE, '999,999,999,999,990') AS STOCK_PRICE, TO_CHAR(A.STOCK_AMT, '999,999,999,999,990') AS STOCK_AMT FROM KEP_STOCK_GR A INNER JOIN ICOMCOD1 B ON (1 = 1 AND B.TYPE = 'SR01' AND B.CODE = A.SITE ) WHERE A.SITE = #{st_site} AND A.YYYYMM = #{st_yyyymm} AND A.ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no}
